brief: Create an 8-slide board proposal named Nordbolt diligence. All data is fictional for testing. Revenue EUR 212m and EBITDA EUR 31m imply a 14.6% margin. A regions slide shows a bar chart of the market: 2021 EUR 8.1bn, 2025 EUR 9.4bn, 2028 forecast EUR 10.6bn on the left and our 2.3% share on the right. A bridge slide shows EBITDA 2023 EUR 24m, price +6.5m, volume +3.2m, materials -4.1m, opex +1.4m, EBITDA 2025 EUR 31m. Compare scope B (25 interviews, EUR 320k, 4 weeks) with scope C (25 interviews plus survey, EUR 410k, 5 weeks). Recommend B because it tests price risk before the bid deadline. Include an eight-row fee table totaling EUR 320k. A roadmap has weeks 1 to 4: market model, interviews, synthesis, investment committee pack. Ask: CFO confirms scope B on 2026-10-09; partner signs the engagement letter on 2026-10-12.
